segment.source: Are there any questions?<end>

segment.source: <end>

segment.source: What is the dark territory, exactly?<end>
segment.target: What is the dark territory, exactly?<end>

segment.source:
The railways used and maintained by Underrail Express are but a fraction of the sprawling railways Biocorp used to operate. Much of that has been abandoned in the last century, and even that has diminished in the last couple of decades. No direct traffic control, no signaling systems - and if you go further, not even lights.
That is the dark territory.<end>

segment.source: And if you look north beyond this point, kid, you'll see it. Or to put it more accurately, you'll see nothing.<end>

segment.source: Then how do you know where we're headed?<end>
segment.target: Then how do you know where we're headed?<end>

segment.source:
We have multiple old transregional maps merged into one. It should be an accurate representation of the railways from the time period.
The state of the railway... that's a different story altogether.<end>

segment.source: How long is the trip going to take?<end>
segment.target: How long is the trip going to take?<end>

segment.source: Could be a few days, could be a week.<end>
segment.target: Could be a few days, could be a week.<end>

segment.source:
It wholly depends on the route we take, and that depends on the condition of the tracks and other factors. It is what it is, but we're not going unprepared.
We got plenty of food, water and supplies.<end>

segment.target: When exactly do we get paid?<end>

segment.source: As soon as we depart.<end>
segment.target: As soon as we depart.<end>

segment.source: Half up front, half when we get to our destination. No other arrangements.<end>
segment.target: Half up front, half when we get to our destination. No other arrangements.<end>

segment.source: What sort of hazards can we expect to encounter?<end>
segment.target: What sort of hazards can we expect to encounter?<end>

segment.source: It's difficult to tell, but toxic or flammable gasses are my number one concern, followed by unstable ground or ceiling. ::He nods.::<end>
segment.target: It's difficult to tell, but toxic or flammable gasses are my number one concern, followed by unstable ground or ceiling. ::He nods.::<end>

segment.source: The railcar is powered by its own batteries, so we're independent from the tracks in that regard. Still, I wouldn't exclude faulty electrical systems from the equation.<end>
segment.target: The railcar is powered by its own batteries, so we're independent from the tracks in that regard. Still, I wouldn't exclude faulty electrical systems from the equation.<end>

segment.source: Bandits, wildlife, rogue bots?<end>
segment.target: Bandits, wildlife, rogue bots?<end>

segment.source: Expect anything and everything.<end>
segment.target: Expect anything and everything.<end>

segment.source: We're less likely to encounter bandits the deeper we go into dark territory. More likely everything else.<end>
segment.target: We're less likely to encounter bandits the deeper we go into dark territory. More likely everything else.<end>

segment.source: Count me in. About time I finally leave South Underrail.<end>
segment.target: Count me in. About time I finally leave South Underrail.<end>

segment.source: Well done. Well done. We now got a crew.<end>

Sorry about earlier, sen-- ::He looks at Wilkos.:: Mr. Nimble. Buck.<end>
